labHead.name: Dr Daniel L. Priebbenow
labHead.title: Senior Lecturer & Deputy Theme Leader (Medicinal Chemistry)
labHead.bio: Dan completed his PhD in Synthetic Organic Chemistry at Deakin University. He was subsequently awarded an Alexander von Humboldt Postdoctoral Fellowship at RWTH Aachen University (Germany). After several years as a postdoctoral fellow at the Australian Translational Medicinal Chemistry Facility, Monash Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Dan began his independent career as an ARC DECRA Fellow at the University of Melbourne. In 2022, Dan joined the Monash Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences where he is currently a Senior Lecturer and Deputy Theme Leader (Medicinal Chemistry).
